# Skill: Create Instagram Caption

## Goal
Create a clean Instagram caption for the latest blog post.

## Inputs
- `photography/out/latest_post.json`
- `DEFAULT_HASHTAGS`
- `CTA_TEXT`

## Outputs
- `photography/out/instagram_draft.json`

## Caption structure
1. Title hook
2. One short summary block
3. CTA line
4. Blog URL
5. Hashtags

## Rules
- Keep the text compact and readable.
- Do not invent facts beyond the source content.
- Preserve the canonical blog URL.
